_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Moves a board item to a new status, stamps dates, and can draft the linked changelog post on release.

description: Change a roadmap/board item status (stamps dates; on release drafts the changelog post and links both ways). Never hand-edit *At, daysToRelease, or votes.

at.description: ISO date for the status stamp (backfill).

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

draftChangelog.description: Default true when the board defines a changelog collection.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

publish.description: Publish the touched keys after staging.

reply.description: Decline reply when moving to an archived state.

status.description: One of the board states from get_collection_schema.

name: set_item_status
